_about: REF-011 World->Gameplay anchor contract for the sales floor; ART-007 builds the anchors from it. Gameplay finds anchors by NAME (GameObject.Find), never by position or order in this file. pos_ft = [x, y] in the ROOM_FIXTURES / REFERENCES_INDEX 1.2 frame (feet, origin Retail NW outer corner, +x east, +y south; Unity X = x*0.3048, Z = -y*0.3048). facing = compass direction the person at the anchor looks; yaw_deg 0 = plan north, 90 = east (graybox convention). aliases = older names already used in code (SLICE_DESIGN 7, GAME-008, GrayboxBuilder): ART-007 creates each alias as an extra empty at the same pose so existing lookups keep working until Gameplay migrates. Anchor_QueueSlot_0..3 = Anchor_Queue_0..3; Anchor_CheckInDesk = Anchor_CheckIn; Anchor_ServiceCustomer / Anchor_ServicePlayer = the player station's _Call / _Operator (station 08 today, GAP-134). Positions that are guesses are Low with a GAP id (GAP-130/131/134, Docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md). REF-013 frame note: A011 prints the retail interior 30'-6" deep vs the V5 frame's 29.0 (GAP-125 family); south-run and south-wall features are placed by their A011/A901 distance from the south wall (y 29.0), west-wall features (entry, ID stand) by their distance from the north wall (y 0), which matches the V5 ATM to 0.3 ft. Station numbers are zero-padded to 2 digits (Anchor_Register_02_Call ... Anchor_Register_12_Operator).
version: REF-013 2026-10-30 v2 (spawn/exit on the parking side per G000 + DEC-110 W4; entry/check-in per A011; south and east register anchors measured; v1 = REF-011)

player_station.note: [GDD] placeholder: station 08 (graybox stations.slice) holds Interact_Terminal / Interact_Scale. In the real store the GM assigns registers on a floor map (DEC-079, DEC-103 (7)), so no single real station exists; Gameplay may assign it per shift

anchors.name: Anchor_CustomerSpawn
anchors.source: G000 key plan (TI set p.1) vector, scaled 3.75 pt/ft from the building outline and checked by its 18.2 ft stalls at 9.1 ft pitch and 24.3 ft drive aisle: west parking row with stall heads 32.3 ft west of the building face, drive aisle, 8.0 ft walk along the building; DEC-110 W4: customers mostly walk straight from the parking lot to the west door; door centre y 11.9 (A011)
anchors.note: parking-side stall heads opposite the entry; the walk crosses the drive aisle and the 8 ft walk. Sometimes from the sidewalk (DEC-110 W4): the McDowell sidewalk (north, about y -10.4 to -3.5) joins the building walk at the NW corner; Gameplay may add that variant
